guideExample: Training helps staff stay in control of the change.

previousTakeaway.en: Feedback helps people stay in control of the change when it can alter the next step.
previousTakeaway.zh: 回饋若能改變下一步，就能幫助人們掌握變革。

revisedTakeaway.en: The museum guides stayed in control of the change by voting on the visitor route before it was introduced.
revisedTakeaway.zh: 博物館的導覽員在新參觀路線推出前投票決定路線，因而仍能掌握這項變革。

findings.evidence: The inflected target stayed in control of the change matches the approved detector. Voting on the visitor route before launch supplies a concrete decision, so the guides had influence over the transition instead of merely being informed. The Chinese keeps both the before-launch timing and this agency.

The guide links training and staff; the revised sentence describes museum guides voting on a visitor route. It changes the actor, causal mechanism, setting, tense and factual detail, rather than restating the guide. A normalized six-word-window check against all 2,604 guide examples found no match in the new English sentence.
